raw.details:
Overview

National-Level Deep-Tech Innovation Hackathon

Central India Hackathon 4.0 (CIH 4.0) is a national-level Deep-Tech Innovation Hackathon organized by Suryodaya College of Engineering & Technology (SCET), Nagpur, and Suryodaya Technology Business Incubation Foundation (STBIF), bringing together innovators, developers, engineers and researchers from across India to develop solutions for real-world challenges.

Building on the success of CIH 1.0, CIH 2.0 and CIH 3.0, this edition focuses on advanced technologies, next-generation engineering and Deep-Tech innovation.

CIH 3.0 achieved a remarkable milestone with maximum participation in an offline, SDG-focused hackathon, bringing together innovators to address challenges aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.

Be Part of History!

CIH 4.0 aims to make history!

This edition aspires to establish a record for the Largest Deep-Tech Innovation Hackathon, seeking recognition from the International Book of Records.

This is your opportunity to be counted, be recognized and be part of something bigger!

Event Highlights

  • Event: Central India Hackathon 4.0 (CIH 4.0)
  • Category: National-Level Deep-Tech Innovation Hackathon
  • Domain: Advanced Technology & Deep-Tech Development
  • Mode: Hybrid (Virtual Rounds + Offline Grand Finale)
  • Grand Finale Venue: Suryodaya College of Engineering & Technology, Nagpur, Maharashtra
  • Grand Finale Duration: 24 Hours
  • Team Size: Strictly 4 Members
  • Total Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000+
  • Special Initiative: Attempting to establish a record for the Largest Deep-Tech Innovation Hackathon with recognition sought from the International Book of Records.

CIH 4.0 focuses on five major technology domains:

  • Advanced AI, Agentic Intelligence & Cognitive Systems
  • Advanced Robotics, Autonomous Systems & Intelligent Automation
  • Semiconductors, Embedded Intelligence, Edge Computing & Cyber-Physical Systems
  • SpaceTech, Aerospace, Defence & Strategic Technologies
  • Advanced Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering & Life Sciences

Participants are encouraged to develop innovative, scalable and impactful solutions using emerging technologies across these domains.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to students from AICTE-approved and other recognized/approved colleges and universities across India.
  • Strictly 4 members per team.
  • Interdisciplinary and cross-college teams are encouraged, subject to registration guidelines.
  • Students from relevant technical and non-technical backgrounds are welcome.
  • All team members must be registered as part of the same team.

Why Participate in CIH 4.0?

  • Become part of an ambitious International Book of Records attempt.
  • Contribute to a record-breaking Deep-Tech innovation initiative.
  • Explore five advanced technology domains.
  • Work on real-world challenges using emerging technologies.
  • Receive mentorship from industry experts and domain specialists.
  • Develop functional prototypes during a 24-hour hackathon.
  • Win prizes worth ₹1,00,000+
  • Network with innovators, entrepreneurs and technology enthusiasts.
  • Gain national-level recognition and strengthen your technical portfolio.

Hackathon Format & Timeline

The hackathon will be conducted in three phases.

Phase 1: Registration & PPT Submission

Registration Period: 1 November - 30 November 2026

  • Register your team through Unstop.
  • Choose your own Deep-Tech Problem Statement (PS).
  • Identify a real-world problem aligned with any of the five hackathon domains.
  • Develop an innovative solution approach.
  • Prepare and submit a PowerPoint presentation (PPT) explaining your proposed solution.
  • Mandatory: All teams must use the official CIH 4.0 PPT Template, available in the "Brief/Case" or "Download Attachments" section on Unstop.
  • Teams must strictly follow the provided template without modifying its structure, design or prescribed format.

IMPORTANT: MANDATORY PPT TEMPLATE

Submission using any other PPT template or making unauthorized changes to the official CIH 4.0 template will lead to disqualification of the team. Teams are advised to download the official template and carefully follow all instructions before preparing their submissions.

PPT Submission Deadline: 30 November 2026

Phase 2: Virtual Round (Idea Presentation)

Dates: 15 December - 25 December 2026

  • Registered teams will present their proposed solutions virtually.
  • Teams must explain their selected problem statement, innovation and technical approach.
  • Presentations will be evaluated by experienced mentors and judges.
  • Evaluation will focus on innovation, technical feasibility, scalability and potential real-world impact.
  • Selected teams will advance to the Offline Grand Finale.

Grand Finale Registration Fee: ₹1,500 per shortlisted team, payable only after selection to confirm participation in the Grand Finale.

Phase 3: Grand Finale (24-Hour Offline Hackathon)

Dates: 22 - 23 January 2027

Venue: Suryodaya College of Engineering & Technology, Nagpur, Maharashtra.

Shortlisted teams will participate in an intensive 24-hour Deep-Tech Innovation Hackathon.

Activities:

  • On-campus reporting and team verification.
  • Official inauguration and hackathon briefing.
  • On-the-spot Deep-Tech Problem Statements.
  • 24-hour intensive development challenge.
  • Prototype development and implementation.
  • Technical mentorship and expert guidance.
  • Final project presentation and live demonstration.
  • Jury evaluation and winner announcement.

Prize Pool Details

Total Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000 + Goodies

Outstanding teams will be rewarded for their innovation, technical excellence and real-world impact. Detailed prize distribution and category-wise rewards will be announced through official event platforms.

Aiming for the International Book of Records!

CIH 4.0 is setting its sights on the International Book of Records, with an ambitious attempt to establish the record for the Largest Deep-Tech Innovation Hackathon.

Join CIH 4.0, register your team and become one of the participants contributing to this record-breaking attempt.

Important Updates & Announcements

All official updates, instructions, schedules, shortlisting results and announcements related to CIH 4.0 will be shared through our official platforms.

Be a Part of History. Be a Part of CIH 4.0!
